Searched 'diwali' internally: returned a non-discriminating totalCount (70) with no Diwali nav/sitemap presence anywhere (checked sitemap-plp.xml for diwali/holi/festival/eid/navratri terms - zero matches) - correctly absent, not an error. Christmas, Halloween and Thanksgiving each modeled as a top-level grouping row (qty/link blank) because the hub URL itself aggregates all children and duplicates their quantities; single-page holidays (Easter, Valentine's Day, New Year, St. Patrick's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Fourth of July, Lunar New Year, Passover, International Women's Day, Fall) have no further site subdivision so are recorded as one row each with sub_category = category name.
